## Try FruitMeasureApp

- Download the app and start measuring fruit size directly from your smartphone.
- You can try the app with test images, without needing to print the support or capture images in the field. Download them at the following link:

::: {.resource-cta-group}
[Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.anphis.es.fruit_measure_app){.btn-store .btn-store--outline}
[Apple Store](https://apps.apple.com/es/app/fruitmeasureapp/id6758163918){.btn-store .btn-store--outline}
[Download test images →](https://github.com/dcg-udl-cat/fruitmeasureapp.udl.cat/releases/download/1.0/imatges_test_app.zip){.btn-store .btn-store--outline}

## Explore the AI model {style="text-align:center;"}

- The application integrates a convolutional neural network (CNN) for fruit detection.
- A geometric calibration using the reference marker located at the end of the FruitMeasureStick enables accurate fruit measurement.
- The CNN has been trained using images of 4,500 fruits collected over four growing seasons (2023–2026).
- It allows users to select between two estimation models: Cluster (small fruits growing in clusters) and Fruit (for individual apples).
